properties.name: FIELD REPORT (bhome, Session 2, 2026-09-16): the reflow2↔IfcMCP loop CLOSED — a 280 sq ft floor-area limit the design called an estimate was measured off an IFC shell at 288.9 sq ft, written back as `subject: record`, and budget_report then said "exceeded by 8, and all ten contributions are still estimated"; the seam was `basis: measured` all along and nothing pointed at it; nine calls failed on version skew; reflow2 has no word for design apparatus
properties.statement:
Reported by the agent on /home/ajs7/project/bhome (its file: feedback.md lines 710–994, Session 2 and 2 part 2; copied to docs/feedback/2026-09-16-bhome-cad-demo-feedback.md). ifc (IfcMCP) and blender mounted beside reflow2; Blender's addon was not running and "turned out not to matter, because Blender returns pictures and IFC returns numbers".

⭐ THE LOOP, in order: con:interior-floor-area held 280 sq ft and said of itself "an estimate with the assumption named, not a measurement". A 40 ft high-cube shell was built in IFC4 at ISO nominal (spatial hierarchy, four walls, floor and roof slabs, an interior space, a finish-floor slab inside a 2 in service cavity). ifc_quantify → Qto_SlabBaseQuantities.GrossArea = 26.8425 m² = 288.9 sq ft, cross-checked against wall Length 12.192 / Height 2.698 / Width 0.043. Written back with record_change (constraint_change, subject: record — "the shell did not change, our knowledge of it did"), limit revised 280→288.9 with provenance in the statement. budget_report → verdict exceeded, total 297 against 288.9, basis_coverage {estimated: 10}. "The design now says: you are 8 sq ft over a limit we measured, and every one of the ten things spending against it is still a guess. Before today it said: you are 17 sq ft over a limit we guessed." The estimate was conservative by 3 %; the measurement did not rescue the design. Recorded honestly: a measurement taken off a model built on two assumptions (manufacturer-typical clear dimensions; an assumed service cavity), and ver:floor-area-take-off records the procedure.

⭐ HEADLINE: the seam ALREADY EXISTED — constrains' `basis: measured` against a budget Constraint — and the agent did not find it while designing; it found it afterwards running find_tools to write the report. During the work it reasoned inside the relation vocabulary, concluded nothing honest fit, and drew no edge. "An agent reasoning carefully inside the relation vocabulary does not discover that a typed constructor covers the case" — second instance after EVOLVES_INTO. Ask: a cad-handoff skill, or two sentences in constrains: design the budget in reflow2, measure it in the tool, write it back as basis: measured, let budget_report say whether it fits.

WHAT WORKED because a partner was coming: the 3D-model EXCLUSION was in the graph in the user's words as an answer to a Question, search_design surfaced it, and because it was traceable to a question about deliverables the collision was diagnosed as scope, not substance, and narrowed rather than overturned. record_change snapshotted the requirement and its edges before the wording changed. The stop hook's nudge timestamps its own reading and says not to trust it; all three findings it raised were correct and none was debt — acknowledge_gaps with a reason each, "not a fabricated artifact".

FRICTION: nine calls failed on version skew (add_decision ×3 — statement/decision, missing id, related_to shape; review_relations relations/links; propagate_from node_id/seed_ids; record_change description/target_type; add_epoch sequence; satisfies coverage; contains parent_id/project_id; acknowledge_gaps gaps/gap_ids) — "the error messages are best-in-class … the cost is structural: ~8 extra round trips clustered at the moment an agent writes a batch"; errors arrive one field at a time; the skew is silent until the first failure. The duplicate guard fired on the 4th of 4 parallel add_decision calls, order-dependent. satisfies REJECTS `coverage` while the stored SATISFIES edge carries coverage: full and graph_report's delivery roll reads it — a capability that only partly satisfies is recorded as fully satisfying. reflow2 has no word for DESIGN APPARATUS: the geometry model had to be a Component whose description disclaims its own type ("NOT A PART OF THE POD"); cap:produce-build-package has sat unallocated for the same reason. An accepted sequencing decision does not suppress findings for its own deferred steps. subject: record is the single most common case a measuring partner will produce and the tool description does not say so. SAVE CADENCE: ifc_render crashed the server and lost units and placements added after the last ifc_save while the artifact was checksummed against the earlier file — "reflow2 knows when a file it tracks has drifted; it has no notion that an external tool holds unsaved state the file does not".

IFC-SIDE (not reflow2's, bounds what an agent can drive): dicts and lists must be passed as JSON strings inside params; a scalar is accepted where a list is required; ifc_quantify and ifc_select disagree about selectors; IfcSpace gets no base quantities; no units ⇒ no drawings, with an error naming attribute 8; ifc_render crashes the server; ifc_plot needs CairoSVG, not installed. Unproven: drawing generation, rendering, Blender entirely, and any measurement of the ten contributions.
